test_title: PYST 68: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The teacher explained the topic **so clearly that no one had doubts.**

options.text: very clearly that no one had doubts
so clearly that no one had any doubts
in such clear way that no doubt remained
clearly so that no doubts were there

solution:
The correct answer is '**so clearly that no one had any doubts**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**so clearly that no one had any doubts**" is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning of the sentence without any ambiguity.
 
• The use of "**any**" in the phrase adds clarity and correctness to the sentence.
